verdict.rationale: OCI offers programmable building blocks for automation: CLI, SDKs, REST APIs, a Terraform provider with Resource Manager jobs, and the Select AI Agent Framework, whose agent teams can be granted for other users to run. Community reports show users running background work themselves, such as cronjobs and Jenkins CI on OCI VMs. Background automation is achievable but self-assembled, with no documented native capability for scheduled or autonomous runs. Missing for 10: a documented native scheduler or event-triggered automation service, evidence that agents run autonomously in the background, and hands-on corroboration of background agent workflows.
